en: The postcard features a black and white photograph showing a tree-lined path in a wooded park area, with two figures standing in the distance. The top portion of the card is filled with handwritten text. Above the photo are printed words reading 'Hälsning från Stockholms Skärgård' and below the photo, text reads 'Parkinteriör från villaområdet Skarpöborg vid Vaxholm.' The reverse side of the postcard displays more handwritten address information, a Swedish stamp, and postal markings including 'Vänersborg'.
